feedback_lines.feedback: The iterative approach using a while loop to simulate the snail's climb is correct, but it will lead to a very inefficient solution for large values of H. This works because the snail effectively climbs A-B meters per day, and needs to climb H-B meters in total (since it slides back B meters on the last night but still reaches the top).
